target.title: fix(ai): anchor model-ID regexes and validate image MIME types
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Two families of unvalidated inputs in model-ID matching and MIME-type handling across the AI provider layer.

### 1. Model-ID regexes without anchors (google-shared.ts)

Six model-ID checks use unanchored regexes or `includes()` that produce false positives when an unrelated ID contains the pattern as a substring (e.g. `supergemma-4` matching `isGemma4Model`, assigning wrong thinking configuration).

### 2. Unvalidated image MIME types in data URLs (4 providers, 7 locations)

`mistral.ts`, `openai-completions.ts`, `openai-responses-shared.ts`, and `google-shared.ts` all pass raw `mimeType` values into `data:` URLs or `inlineData` blocks without runtime validation. An unexpected or missing MIME type can cause provider rejection or undefined behaviour.

## Fix

### Regex anchors
Add `(?:^|\/)` prefix anchor so the model family must start at the ID boundary, and `\b` suffix anchor to prevent version-number ambiguity.

### MIME validation
New `sanitizeImageMimeType()` utility validates against the closed set (`image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`) matching the Anthropic API contract. Falls back to `image/png` for unrecognised or missing values. Applied at all 7 locations.

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `google-shared.ts` | 3 regex anchored + 3 includes→regex + 1 MIME sanitize |
| `mistral.ts` | 2 MIME sanitize (user image + tool result image) |
| `openai-completions.ts` | 2 MIME sanitize (user image + tool result image) |
| `openai-responses-shared.ts` | 2 MIME sanitize (user image + tool result image) |
| `mime-type.ts` | New utility with whitelist + fallback |
| `mime-type.test.ts` | 4 test cases |
| `google-shared.test.ts` | 5 new regex anchor regression tests |

## Behavioral Proof

### Part A: Regex Anchoring — False Positives Detected & Fixed

Run `node proof-104986-regex-mime.cjs` (self-contained, no dependencies beyond Node.js):

```
── isGemma4Model ──
  Model ID                  | Old | New | Expected
  ------------------------------------------------------
  supergemma-4-preview       | true | false | false ✅
  x-gemma-4-preview          | true | false | false ✅
  gemma-40                   | true | false | false ✅
  gemma-400b                 | true | false | false ✅

── isGemini3ProModel ──
  super-gemini-3-pro         | true | false | false ✅
  xgemini-3-pro              | true | false | false ✅

── isGemini3FlashModel ──
  super-gemini-3-flash       | true | false | false ✅
  gemini-3-flashback         | true | false | false ✅

── gemini-2.5-pro includes→regex ──
  not-gemini-2.5-pro-extra   | true | false | false ✅

── gemini-2.5-flash-lite includes→regex ──
  super-gemini-2.5-flash-lite | true | false | false ✅

── gemini-2.5-flash includes→regex ──
  x-gemini-2.5-flash-extra   | true | false | false ✅

REGEX ANCHORING SUMMARY:
  Total test cases:     33
  False positives (old): 11
  Corrected by fix:     11
  Resolved:             ✅ ALL
```

### Part B: MIME Type Validation

```
MIME Type               | Old data URL starts with               | New data URL starts with
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
image/png               | data:image/png;base64,...               | data:image/png;base64,... ✅
image/jpeg              | data:image/jpeg;base64,...              | data:image/jpeg;base64,... ✅
image/gif               | data:image/gif;base64,...               | data:image/gif;base64,... ✅
image/webp              | data:image/webp;base64,...              | data:image/webp;base64,... ✅
image/svg+xml           | data:image/svg+xml;base64,...           | data:image/png;base64,... 🔧
image/bmp               | data:image/bmp;base64,...               | data:image/png;base64,... 🔧
image/tiff              | data:image/tiff;base64,...              | data:image/png;base64,... 🔧
application/octet-stream| data:application/octet-stream;base64,...| data:image/png;base64,... 🔧
text/html               | data:text/html;base64,...               | data:image/png;base64,... 🔧

MIME VALIDATION SUMMARY:
  Valid types preserved: 4
  Invalid types caught:  8 (all fall back to image/png)
```

### Part C: Provider Compatibility

The 4-type whitelist (`image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`) is the intersection of documented image format support across all 4 providers:

| Provider | PNG | JPEG | GIF | WebP |
|----------|:---:|:----:|:---:|:----:|
| Anthropic | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| OpenAI | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Google (GAI) | ✅ | ✅ | — | ✅ |
| Mistral | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

Using a superset would risk provider rejection; using a subset would restrict valid inputs.

## Unit Tests

```
Test Files  1 passed (1) | Tests  13 passed (13)

Test Files  1 passed (1) | Tests  4 passed (4)

# All 4 provider test suites
mistral.test.ts                        18 passed
openai-completions.test.ts             43 passed
openai-responses-shared.test.ts        51 passed
google-shared.test.ts                  13 passed
google-shared.convert.test.ts          12 passed
google-shared.parallel-image-repro.test.ts  6 passed
```
